In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and performance analysis of four nonlinear controllers: PD, PID, PD with integral action and PD with sliding mode.
the performance analysis of four positioning controllers for a unicycle-like robot.
the performance analysis of the controllers.

the controllers are equivalent in performance.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the controllers presented are able to perform the positioning mission in the same time and energy.
, the controllers are able to achieve good performance in terms of IAE index and convergence time, and the energy consumption is similar for the controllers.

the controller that has the best performance in simulation does not necessary have the best performance in the practice, because the simulation is not a good predictor of the real behavior of the robot.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the controllers can be compared by the indexes IAE, ITASE and IASC, in order to select the most adequate for the mission accomplishment, considering the convergence time and the energy consumption.
the ITAE and IASE indexes are good indicators of the controller performance in terms of energy and convergence time.
ITAE and IAE indexes are not suitable for the analysis of nonlinear systems, while IASC index is a good alternative for this analysis.
